about_the_game:
An erotic click-through VISUAL NOVEL featuring HD graphics, and realistic-looking characters.

Tempted by rumors of a secret glory hole, Annie and Nadia take their fathers to a stylish new bar downtown to celebrate their new partnership.

Will the girls be bold enough to give the glory hole a try?

Dive into this steamy family drama and discover how their story unfolds!

GAME DESCRIPTION 

EPISODE 7
 

The high-stakes deal between David and Anthony is finally signed, and there’s only one thing left to do—celebrate. Craving a wild night with their fathers, Annie and Nadia guide them to a stylish new bar downtown, intrigued by whispers of a secret glory hole tucked away in the back.

But when they arrive, the men try to temper their daughters’ excitement with soft drinks, giving the opportunistic bartender the perfect chance to swoop in and steal the spotlight. Relishing their fathers’ frustration, the girls use the charming bartender to make them jealous, reminding them they’re not so easily tamed.

Determined to regain control, Tony and David dare their wild daughters to put on a show at the very spot that piqued their curiosity. But will Annie and Nadia be bold enough to explore the glory hole with their fathers watching? 

Dive into this steamy family drama and discover how their story unfolds!
